A `muninn why` query on the wire format returned "insufficient". The only related mention was a bare "zstd" note from an earlier session. That is a compression algorithm, not a serialisation format, and it has no task or decision attached, so I left it out.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file-write tool instead.
